decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting runs on long defense procurement cycles, so two years reveal little about its value, and the low cost of keeping this specialist line justifies leaving the option open.
The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio and costs little to maintain, and nothing so far shows its value will not be realized, so the option stays open.
As a second-generation core interior luminaire with its own page, it carries low uncertainty and fits the established business, which warrants continued commitment.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship of the firm's direction toward efficient, glare-free LED lighting, so it is a strategic option worth further investment.
HMI technology is increasingly being replaced by LED, which raises the chance of abandonment, but the marine niche line is still cheap to hold while customer demand for HMI remains.
The marine searchlight serves the robust specialist segment at little cost, and the results so far do not reveal enough to justify abandoning it.
